# Benchmarks

Two committed, fully reproducible benchmarks: a single deep block where all six methods (including the single-block-only `topology` optimizer) run head-to-head, and a settlement-scale region where the scalable methods are graded on the benefit-vs-added-road frontier.

## One deep block, six methods

Block `ZAF.9.3.1_1_40972` — the deepest block (by the depth proxy `sqrt(n*A)/P`) small enough for `topology` to run: 263 parcels, up to 7 rings deep, auto-picked with no hand tuning.

![before](assets/method-comparison/before.jpg)

After, per method:

| clearance | clearance_looped | euclidean_grid |

| greedy_arterial_repulsion | osm_footpaths | topology |
|---|---|---|
| ![greedy_arterial_repulsion](assets/method-comparison/after_greedy_arterial_repulsion.jpg) | ![osm_footpaths](assets/method-comparison/after_osm_footpaths.jpg) | ![topology](assets/method-comparison/after_topology.jpg) |


Terminal (full build-out) point of each method's frontier:

| method | external connectivity | internal connectivity | road built (m) | homes displaced | % of homes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clearance_looped` | 0.92 | 0.32 | 1,300 | 203 | 77.2% |
| `topology` | 0.92 | 0.04 | 934 | 160 | 60.9% |
| `euclidean_grid` | 0.79 | 0.41 | 741 | 112 | 42.4% |
| `clearance` | 0.83 | 0.00 | 486 | 88 | 33.4% |
| `osm_footpaths` | 0.76 | 0.33 | 639 | 75 | 28.4% |
| `greedy_arterial_repulsion` | 0.84 | 0.47 | 703 | 75 | 28.4% |

## Settlement scale: the `multiblock_depth` region

The `depth` metric screened **13,793 of 83,192** Cape Town blocks and grew the top-scoring block (`ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810`, peel depth 24) into a **12-block region of 11,006 parcels** — mean depth 6.4 rings, mean density 99 buildings/ha.

[See the region on Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/@-33.84562,18.74451,15z)

![screen.jpg](assets/multiblock_depth/screen.jpg)

![region.jpg](assets/multiblock_depth/region.jpg)

### The benefit-vs-road frontier

Each method's benefit as cumulative added road grows — external connectivity (access burden removed), internal connectivity (backup-route redundancy), and displacement (a rising cost):

![depth_vs_road_ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810](assets/multiblock_depth/depth_vs_road_ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810.png)

![curve_external_connectivity_ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810](assets/multiblock_depth/curve_external_connectivity_ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810.png)

![curve_internal_connectivity_ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810](assets/multiblock_depth/curve_internal_connectivity_ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810.png)

![displacement_ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810](assets/multiblock_depth/displacement_ZAF.9.3.1_1_5810.png)

### Lens A — road needed to reach external connectivity 0.70

| method | reached | external connectivity | road (m) | homes displaced | % of homes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `greedy_arterial_repulsion` | yes | 0.70 | 4,938 | 403 | 3.7% |
| `clearance_looped` | yes | 0.73 | 2,804 | 279 | 2.5% |
| `euclidean_grid` | yes | 0.74 | 3,934 | 386 | 3.5% |
| `osm_footpaths` | **no** | 0.03 | 7,674 | 387 | 3.5% |

### Lens B — every method at the same 7,674 m road budget

| method | external connectivity | internal connectivity | homes displaced | % of homes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `greedy_arterial_repulsion` | 0.78 | 0.13 | 552 | 5.0% |
| `clearance_looped` | 0.91 | 0.26 | 848 | 7.7% |
| `euclidean_grid` | 0.83 | 0.31 | 748 | 6.8% |
| `osm_footpaths` | 0.03 | 0.09 | 387 | 3.5% |

### Reproduce

The whole benchmark — data, maps, curves, tables — regenerates from one self-logging command:

```bash
pixi run python -m scripts.gen_multiblock_example depth
```
